Operations.Name: BootAttach
Operations.Description:
Attach a disk to the boot pool, turning a stripe into a mirror.

`expand` option will determine whether the new disk partition will be
         the maximum available or the same size as the current disk.

Arguments.Name: dev
Arguments.Description: Device name or path to attach to the boot pool.

Arguments.Name: dev
Arguments.Description: Device name or path to detach from the boot pool.

Operations.Name: BootGetDisks
Operations.Description: Returns disks of the boot pool.

Operations.Name: BootGetState
Operations.Description: Returns the current state of the boot pool, including all vdevs, properties and datasets.

Operations.Name: BootReplace
Operations.Description: Replace device `label` on boot pool with `dev`.

Arguments.Name: label
Arguments.Description: Label of the disk in the boot pool to replace.

Arguments.Name: dev
Arguments.Description: Device name or path of the replacement disk.

Operations.Name: BootSetScrubInterval
Operations.Description: Set Automatic Scrub Interval value in days.

Arguments.Name: interval
Arguments.Description: Scrub interval in days (must be a positive integer).

Fields.Name: Expand
Fields.Description: Whether to expand the boot pool after attaching the disk.

Models.Name: BootGetStateAnswer
Models.Description: Current state and configuration of the boot pool.

Fields.Name: Allocated
Fields.Description: Amount of space currently allocated in the pool in bytes. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: AllocatedStr
Fields.Description: Human-readable string representation of allocated space. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Autotrim
Fields.Description: Auto-trim configuration for the pool indicating whether automatic TRIM operations are enabled.

Fields.Name: DedupTableQuota
Fields.Description: Quota limit for the deduplication table. `null` if no quota is set.

Fields.Name: DedupTableSize
Fields.Description: Size of the deduplication table in bytes. `null` if deduplication is not enabled.

Fields.Name: Expand
Fields.Description: Information about any active pool expansion operation. `null` if no expansion is running.

Fields.Name: Fragmentation
Fields.Description: Percentage of pool fragmentation as a string. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Free
Fields.Description: Amount of free space available in the pool in bytes. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: FreeStr
Fields.Description: Human-readable string representation of free space. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Freeing
Fields.Description: Amount of space being freed (in bytes) by ongoing operations. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: FreeingStr
Fields.Description: Human-readable string representation of space being freed. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Healthy
Fields.Description: Whether the pool is in a healthy state with no errors or warnings.

Fields.Name: IsUpgraded
Fields.Description: Whether this pool has been upgraded to the latest feature flags.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name of the storage pool.

Fields.Name: Path
Fields.Description: Filesystem path where the pool is mounted.

Fields.Name: Scan
Fields.Description: Information about any active scrub or resilver operation. `null` if no operation is running.

Fields.Name: Size
Fields.Description: Total size of the pool in bytes. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: SizeStr
Fields.Description: Human-readable string representation of the pool size. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current status of the pool.

Fields.Name: StatusCode
Fields.Description: Detailed status code for the pool condition. `null` if not applicable.

Fields.Name: StatusDetail
Fields.Description: Human-readable description of the pool status. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Topology
Fields.Description: Physical topology and structure of the pool including vdevs. `null` if not available.

Fields.Name: Warning
Fields.Description: Whether the pool has warning conditions that require attention.
